label: Outcome of registration QC - Longitudinal - Insight46 phase 2
meta_rows: Outcome of registration QC - Longitudinal - Insight46 phase 2

Insight46 phase 2 brain volumes measured from T1 MRI as part of the longitudinal pipeline. Note that boundary shift integral measures have been quantified for some regions (whole brain, ventricles, hippocampus) which provide more precise estimates of volume change between phase 1 and 2 compared to indirectly calculating the difference in volume between each time-point. For phase 1 brain volumes measured from T1 MRI as part of longitudinal pipeline  - see library file - I46_brainVolumes_L.
cat_rows: This category contains variables related to the brain volumes (longitudinal measures) parcellated from T1 MRI (phases 1 and 2) from the MRI brain imaging carried out on the participants taking part in the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
